english.title: Racially / religiously aggravated assault / assault occasioning actual bodily harm
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) assaulted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) thereby occasioning

(A)_[him]_
(B)_[her]_

actual bodily harm which was religiously or racially aggravated in accordance with section 28 of the Crime and Disorder Act 1998
english.legislation: Contrary to section 29(1)(b) and (2) of the Crime and Disorder Act 1998.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
assaulted a person occasioning him/her actual bodily harm
the offence was religiously/racially aggravated

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
This CJS Code and Standard Offence Wording is OBSOLETE. Now see CJS Code CD98073 and Offence Wording H10010.

(i) The option to return an alternative verdict of guilty of the basic offence is NOT available in the magistrates court, therefore the basic offence should be charged in addition to the aggravated offence.
(ii) For the racially or religiously wordings see offence wording: H484 and H4722.
